Hi Maya — really glad to hear the demo resonated. Short answers up front: yes, and yes — we have a predictable uplift path and short-term feature add-ons we can attach for pilots.

Details and recommendation:
- Temporary uplift: we support a "burst uplift" that routes traffic to Core-equivalent capacity for up to 30 days. Pricing is charged at a daily uplift rate tied to GPU-hours; we can cap cost with a burst cap you set. No contractual re-sign required for the pilot — we record the uplift as a usage event against the Compact+ subscription.
- Feature add-ons: model rollouts (canary + automatic fallback) + 30d enhanced observability are offered as a Pilot Pack add-on. For pilots we typically price the Pilot Pack as a flat monthly add-on (covers the full pilot window).

Recommended pathway for your procurement meeting: Compact+ base for continuity + Pilot Pack add-on for rollouts/observability + a capped burst uplift for peak reranker days. If you commit to a 6-month pilot run (pilot + integration + early-stage telemetry), we can offer a pilot discount and a one-time onboarding credit.

I attached a short pricing summary (redwood-pricing-summary.pdf) and a sample uplift cap calculation. Would you and procurement have 30 minutes tomorrow (Oct 15) to walk numbers?

Jordan Blake
